transcript: The real winner of the 2026 Jimmy Awards has not been decided yet. And I know what you're thinking. You're thinking, Ben, I watched the awards. So Maya and Jake won. What are you talking about? And they may have walked away with the trophy, but the real prize is going to be whoever ends up booking a role in Spring Awakening off Broadway. Because this was the real Spring Awakening open call. And you just know that casting team was in that audience. They were taking notes. And come tomorrow, they're gonna be picking up that phone and they're gonna be saying, hey, Beverly Bass, wanna come play Elsa? Like, I would bet actual, real life human money that at least two of the cast members in Spring Awakening off Broadway were in this Jimmy Awards. And it could still end up being Samaya and Jake. Like, what a wonderful Melchor and Venla they would be. But it is not a done deal yet. So if you are a Jimmy Awards contestant in line to be in the Spring Awakening revival, stay in line, keep your eye on the real prize, and I look forward to seeing you off Broadway later this year.
